degree_rationale: Final fragmentary teachings on cherubim, the four angels stretched to bear cosmos, the seven pillars, twelve angels, twenty-two angels, the Yes and Amen as Calling-and-Answer. Closes the corpus by sealing the cosmic-natural structure — the Yes/Amen identifying with the Calling/Hearing that became helpers and reigners.
direction_rationale: Closes the entire corpus at sunset: the final sealing-up of the cosmic-natural structure with the Yes-and-Amen as the cardinal completion-words. The west of the natural is also the west of the whole 104.
grand_man_function: Natural ultimate-seal — the Yes-and-Amen closing the cosmic body.
title: Cherubim, pillars, and garments (final teachings, fragmentary)
